<module id="float_multi">
    <description>A 32-bit floating point multiplier for IEEE-754 standard single precision arithmetic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal (active high).</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the multiplication in IEEE 754 format.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INITIALIZE">Initialize counter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="EXTRACT_MANTISSA">Extract mantissas.</parameter>
        <parameter id="EXTRACT_EXPONENT">Extract exponents.</parameter>
        <parameter id="EXTRACT_SIGN">Extract sign bits.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NORMALIZE">Normalize mantissas.</parameter>
        <parameter id="MULTIPLY">Multiply mantissas.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ROUND_ADJUST">Round and adjust exponent.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT_RESULT">Generate output result.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="counter" type="reg" width_description="[2:0]" initial_value="0">
            <description>Cycle counter for operation sequencing.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="a_mantissa" type="reg" width_description="[23:0]">
            <description>Mantissa of input number a.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="b_mantissa" type="reg" width_description="[23:0]">
            <description>Mantissa of input number b.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="z_mantissa" type="reg" width_description="[23:0]">
            <description>Mantissa of output number z.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="a_exponent" type="reg" width_description="[9:0]">
            <description>Exponent of input number a.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="b_exponent" type="reg" width_description="[9:0]">
            <description>Exponent of input number b.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="z_exponent" type="reg" width_description="[9:0]">
            <description>Exponent of output number z.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="a_sign" type="reg">
            <description>Sign bit of input number a.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="b_sign" type="reg">
            <description>Sign bit of input number b.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="z_sign" type="reg">
            <description>Sign bit of output number z.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="product" type="reg" width_description="[49:0]">
            <description>Intermediate product of the mantissas.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="guard_bit" type="reg">
            <description>Guard bit for rounding.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="round_bit" type="reg">
            <description>Rounding bit.</description>
        </register>
        <register id="sticky" type="reg">
            <description>Sticky bit for rounding.</description>
        </register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Counter to keep track of the current stage of the computation
        reg [2:0] counter;
        
        // Extracting mantissas, exponents, and sign bits from input operands
        reg [23:0] a_mantissa, b_mantissa, z_mantissa;
        reg [9:0] a_exponent, b_exponent, z_exponent;
        reg a_sign, b_sign, z_sign;
        
        // Intermediate variables
        reg [49:0] product;
        reg guard_bit, round_bit, sticky;
        
        // Special case handling
        parameter NaN = 32'h7FC00000; // NaN value
        parameter INF = 32'h7F800000; // Infinity value
        
        // State machine for controlling the computation process
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                counter <= 0;
            end else begin
                case(counter)
                    INITIALIZE: begin
                        counter <= EXTRACT_MANTISSA;
                    end
                    
                    EXTRACT_MANTISSA: begin
                        a_mantissa <= {1'b1, a[22:0]};
                        b_mantissa <= {1'b1, b[22:0]};
                        counter <= EXTRACT_EXPONENT;
                    end
                    
                    EXTRACT_EXPONENT: begin
                        a_exponent <= a[30:23];
                        b_exponent <= b[30:23];
                        counter <= EXTRACT_SIGN;
                    end
                    
                    EXTRACT_SIGN: begin
                        a_sign <= a[31];
                        b_sign <= b[31];
                        counter <= NORMALIZE;
                    end
                    
                    NORMALIZE: begin
                        // Normalize mantissas if necessary
                        if(a_mantissa[23]) begin
                            a_mantissa <= a_mantissa >> 1;
                            a_exponent <= a_exponent + 1;
                        end
                        
                        if(b_mantissa[23]) begin
                            b_mantissa <= b_mantissa >> 1;
                            b_exponent <= b_exponent + 1;
                        end
                        
                        counter <= MULTIPLY;
                    end
                    
                    MULTIPLY: begin
                        // Multiply mantissas
                        product <= a_mantissa * b_mantissa;
                        
                        // Adjust exponent
                        z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 127;
                        
                        // Determine sign of output
                        z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
                        
                        counter <= ROUND_ADJUST;
                    end
                    
                    ROUND_ADJUST: begin
                        // Round and adjust exponent
                        guard_bit <= product[23];
                        round_bit <= |product[22:0];
                        sticky <= |(product[21:0]);
                        
                        if(product[24] && (guard_bit || round_bit || sticky)) begin
                            product <= product + 1;
                        end
                        
                        z_mantissa <= product[47:24];
                        
                        counter <= OUTPUT_RESULT;
                    end
                    
                    OUTPUT_RESULT: begin
                        // Handle special cases
                        if((a == NaN) || (b == NaN)) begin
                            z <= NaN;
                        end else if((a == INF) || (b == INF)) begin
                            z <= INF;
                        end else begin
                            // Output the result in IEEE 754 format
                            z <= {z_sign, z_exponent[7:0], z_mantissa[22:0]};
                        end
                        
                        counter <= INITIALIZE;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
    
</module>
